title: Laser removal of silicon solar cell backsheet while preserving tempered glass and silicon wafer
authors: Mahantesh Khetri, Pawan K. Kanaujia, Mool C. Gupta
journal: Solar Energy Materials and Solar Cells
summary: Developed a 1070 nm continuous wave laser process for rapid backsheet delamination from silicon photovoltaic modules while preserving tempered glass and the silicon wafer.

title: Superhydrophilic and Superhydrophobic Surfaces with Reversible Wettability Using Laser Processing
authors: Anustup Chakraborty, Mahantesh Khetri, Atchutananda Surampudi, Mool C. Gupta
summary: Investigated laser surface microtexturing for controllable superhydrophilic and superhydrophobic surface behavior.

title: Laser recycling of silver in bulk and nanoparticle form from silicon solar cells and deep learning for process automation
authors: Mahantesh Khetri, Pawan K. Kanaujia, Mool C. Gupta
summary: Developed laser methods for recovering silver from silicon solar cells in bulk and nanoparticle form and integrated deep learning for automated process targeting and scan-path generation.

title: Gold Metal Recovery from Electronic Waste through Laser Generation of Micro and Nanoparticles
authors: Abhishek Trivedi, Mahantesh Khetri, Atchutananda Surampudi, Mool C. Gupta
summary: Demonstrated laser-based recovery of gold from electronic waste through generation of micro and nanoparticles using modeling, spectroscopy, microscopy, compositional analysis, and LIBS.

title: Recycling of silver from CIGS solar cells using laser ablation and debonding
journal: Solar Energy Materials and Solar Cells
summary: Developed ultraviolet picosecond laser ablation and infrared nanosecond laser debonding approaches for recovering silver from CIGS photovoltaic cells.

title: Recycling of silver from silicon solar cells by laser debonding
summary: Developed a laser debonding method for selective silver contact recovery from silicon solar cells using UV nanosecond and IR continuous wave laser processing.

title: Stabilization of 5 wt percent Sb doped SnO2 thin film by post oxidation of thermally evaporated metallic layer
authors: Mahantesh Khetri, R. Ramarajan, N. Purusotham Reddy, M. Kovendhan, K. V. A. Srivatsav, B. S. Rao, K. Thangaraju, D. Paul Joseph
summary: Developed Sb doped SnO2 transparent conducting oxide thin films by thermal evaporation of Sn Sb alloy layers followed by controlled post oxidation and characterized their structural, optical, and electrical properties.
